recognize_zh: A 圖血清蛋白電泳病人道有兩條異常帶（星號），B 圖免疫固定電泳在 IgG（γ）道出現對應帶（箭頭），但 kappa 與 lambda 道皆無相對應帶，代表只有游離 γ 重鏈；C–E 組織為成片漿細胞樣淋巴球／漿細胞，G、H 輕鏈免疫染色陰性，符合 γ 重鏈病。
features: Panel A: serum protein electrophoresis with two abnormal bands (asterisks) in the patient lane compared with control
Panel B: immunofixation showing bands in the IgG (gamma) lane (arrowheads) without corresponding kappa or lambda bands
Panels C-E (H&E): diffuse sheets of small to medium lymphoplasmacytic cells and plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate cytoplasm
Panels F and I: immunostains with diffuse positivity in the infiltrate (markers not labeled)
Panels G and H: kappa and lambda light-chain stains essentially negative apart from rare cells
describe_en: Composite figure combining protein studies and histology. Serum protein electrophoresis shows two abnormal bands, and immunofixation localizes them to the IgG heavy-chain lane with no matching kappa or lambda light-chain bands, indicating a free gamma heavy chain. Tissue sections show diffuse sheets of lymphoplasmacytic cells and plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, and immunostains show diffuse positivity for markers in panels F and I with absence of kappa and lambda light-chain expression. Findings are consistent with gamma heavy chain disease, here arising in a patient with systemic lupus erythematosus.

ddx.dx: IgG plasma cell myeloma or plasmacytoma
ddx.vs: Myeloma produces an intact IgG with a matching kappa or lambda band on immunofixation and light-chain-restricted plasma cells, whereas heavy chain disease lacks light chains.
LPL usually secretes intact IgM with light-chain restriction and MYD88 L265P, not a free gamma chain without light chains.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic with both kappa and lambda positive cells and polyclonal gammopathy, unlike light-chain-negative sheets with a discrete band.
Alpha HCD involves IgA heavy chain in intestinal mucosa, identified in the IgA lane rather than the IgG lane.
